newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: NAMIBIA STOCKS WEEK - GENBEL BUSY, INDEX EDGES DOWN.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIA STOCKS WEEK - GENBEL BUSY, INDEX EDGES DOWN.

text.p: Africa was the most active stock on the Namibian Stock Exchange
last week trading one million shares in a deal worth N$21.4
The share price had advanced to N$22.10 by the end of the
However, the market's overall index was slightly down at
262.87 from 263.64 the previous week while the local index
finished a touch down at 168.34 from 168.72 at the end of the
Dealers said other active shares included fishing firm
Namibian Sea Products with 465,400 shares traded as the price
retreated to 70 cents from 75. There was also considerable local
selling of Metropolitan Life which traded 377,766 shares at
